changelog: Initial release of Meeting Notes to Action
summary: Turn raw meeting notes or transcripts into structured action: decisions log, action items with owner and deadline, open questions, and a distributable summary email. Extracts who-committed-to-what with date parsing (natural language dates resolved against the meeting date), deduplicates, tracks carryover between meetings, and generates per-owner task lists. Use when the user has meeting notes/transcripts and needs minutes, action items, or a follow-up summary.
